name: C5
kind: daily cross-sectional long/short swing book, Binance USDT-M perps
universe: top-40 USDT perps by 30-day quote volume, re-ranked on the first day of each month, delisted coins included (python -m qforecast.swing.data)
signals: 6 signals of qforecast/swing/signals.py, cross-sectional normal scores, fixed weights below (L1-normalised)
book: every day 1 / 7 of the book is re-picked (7 staggered weekly sub-books). Each sub-book: 0.5 gross long the top 5, 0.5 gross short 8 names from the bottom of the ranking, skipping any short candidate whose 7-day mean funding is negative (shorts there already pay; crowded short, squeeze risk) and taking the next-ranked name, searching down to rank 16. Inverse 28-day-vol legs, 25 % cap per coin; legs scaled to equal beta to BTC; if fewer than 4 shorts are eligible the leg keeps 12.5 % of gross per name and a BTC perp short carries the missing beta. A short whose daily close reaches 1.4 x its entry is bought back and left out until its sub-book re-picks.
costs: 7 bps per side all-in + real funding
